text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is there a history of maternal fever or chorioamnionitis, and has the baby developed any fever or shown signs of infection? I also need to know if there is any family history of genetic lung diseases.

speaker: Patient
